jobs.title: System Engineer (Database Administrator)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Database Administrator (DBA) with strong expertise in Oracle technologies and solid knowledge of other database platforms. The role focuses on the administration, evolution, and migration of enterprise database environments, supporting critical applications and transformation initiatives across the organization.
Your key tasks

• Administer Oracle Database environments as the primary technology, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management

• Manage and support additional database platforms such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, or other NoSQL solutions

• Execute and coordinate database migration projects, including cross-version upgrades, platform migrations, cloud migrations, and database consolidation initiatives

• Plan and perform migrations from on-premise to cloud-based database services, including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, AWS, or Azure

• Support heterogeneous migration scenarios between different database technologies, ensuring data consistency, performance, and minimal service disruption

• Implement and maintain high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, including Oracle Data Guard, RAC, and equivalent technologies for other platforms

• Define and execute backup, restore, and recovery procedures across multiple database systems

• Monitor and optimize database performance, capacity, storage, and resource utilization

• Troubleshoot incidents, performance bottlenecks, replication issues, and database-related application problems

• Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and project teams to design database solutions aligned with business and technical requirements

• Produce technical documentation, operational procedures, migration plans, and handover material

• Contribute to automation and standardization initiatives for database provisioning, patching, and deployment

## Qualifiche

• 4+ years of experience as a Database Administrator, with strong focus on Oracle Database

• Solid hands-on experience with Oracle Database administration in enterprise environments

• Good knowledge of at least one additional database technology, such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, or MongoDB

• Proven experience in database migration activities, including upgrades, platform changes, and cloud migration projects

• Strong knowledge of backup and recovery strategies, business continuity, and disaster recovery concepts

• Experience with performance tuning, SQL optimization, and troubleshooting of complex database issues

• Good understanding of Linux/Unix environments and scripting for automation

• Familiarity with database security, access control, and auditing principles

• Ability to work effectively in project-based environments and coordinate with multiple stakeholders

• Strong communication skills in English

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

jobs.title: German speaking Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced, seasoned, well-rounded program or project manager who delivers legal regulatory and community projects.
Your key tasks

• Purpose: We enjoy what we do. We lead with energy and enthusiasm. We are committed to the organization and the role

• Delivery & Action: We get things done. We are creating actionable plans, and we drive and lead the day-to-day execution of the activities

• Solution-orientation: We identify and develop solutions. We take a holistic, proactive approach to challenges. We are logical thinkers and rigorous analysts, and above everything pragmatic

## Qualifiche

• Good and demonstrable understanding of project management knowledge areas and banking technology

• Flexibility about work content and location, willingness to spend time in our offices in Zurich, Bioggio and Geneva

• Good organizational skills ensuring success in delivery through planning, executing, progress reporting, controlling, reporting and monitoring of the project activities

• Excellent communication skills to foster relationships with clients and team members alike, on all seniority levels

• Problem-solving attitude and proactive approach

• Resilience to stress

• Fluent in German, English and French
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Knowledge of the Avaloq platform and financial services

• Italian language skills

jobs.title: Senior Technical Business Analyst Credits & Risks
jobs.description:
The Credits & Risk team in the Application Management Services (AMS) is responsible to provide application maintenance (bug fixing) and small enhancements services for the functional area and all related topics for our SaaS clients.
Your key tasks

• Closely collaborate with the Team Lead, Business Analysts, and other Software Engineers

• Write solution designs for new developments and have them reviewed with our technical leads and architects

• Participate in client workshops and support our business analysts in requirements analysis

• Design, develop and maintain thought-out solutions within the team’s responsibility

• Improve and optimize existing functionalities

• Develop and maintain automated tests, quality insurance

• Take ownership and responsibility for your area of expertise

• To work with agile mindset, process, and ticketing platforms (Jira)

## Qualifiche

• University degree in Computer Science/Physics/Engineering/Mathematics/Economics/Finance or comparable education

• At least 5 years of work experience in the fintech or financial sector

• Business know-how in Credits applications, loans and the associated risk, overdrafts, interest calculations, etc. is a strong advantage

• Experience in managing Third Party Supplier and/or Outsourcing Providers

• Analytical, problem-solving, data-gathering skills

• Reliable, effective and service oriented

• Fluent in spoken and written English

• Availability to execute planned or exceptional maintenance work during weekends and/or public holidays

• Availability for picket shifts with possible emergency interventions at night or on weekends
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Avaloq ACP Certification

• Italian, German or French language skills

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

jobs.description:
You will be part of the Service Operations – Web & Mobile and Crypto Team, which is responsible for ensuring stable platform operations and the continuous improvement of our Avaloq software and products for our clients.
As a Business Analyst, you will act as a key link between our clients, service teams, and development organizations. You will be responsible for analysing business requirements, investigating and resolving production incidents, and ensuring the smooth operation and availability of business-critical applications. Working closely with clients and internal stakeholders, you will help deliver high-quality solutions that address business needs and enhance the overall client experience.
In this role, you will collaborate with Software Engineers, Service Managers, Product teams, Project Delivery teams, and Client Management to identify root causes, resolve incidents, and drive continuous service improvements. You will contribute throughout the entire software lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design to implementation, testing, deployment, and post-production support.

Your key tasks

• Ensure the stable and efficient operation of Web & Mobile Banking and Crypto solutions and related third-party applications

• Analyse and consolidate client requirements, translating business needs into functional and technical specifications

• Manage incidents and service requests end-to-end, including triage, impact analysis, troubleshooting, coordination, and resolution

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients and stakeholders, managing expectations and ensuring effective communication

• Support the onboarding of new banking services into service delivery and operational support

• Support testing activities, including functional validation and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

• Contribute to the successful delivery of product enhancements and new functionalities

• Maintain clear documentation and actively promote knowledge sharing and best practices within the team

## Qualifiche

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst, or significant experience in the banking or financial services industry with strong business analysis responsibilities

• High level knowledge of web application infrastructure (DNS, firewall, Web application firewall)

• Knowledge of digital banking, mobile banking or web banking platforms

• Familiarity with digital onboarding, authentication, identity management, or security solutions

• Familiarity with cloud environments and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

• Knowledge and experience in RDBMS, Oracle SQL, Oracle PL/SQL

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think conceptually about complex business challenges

• Competencies in log analysis, using unix terminal or elastic search

• Excellent communication and client-orientation skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements

• Self-motivated, proactive, and organized working approach with a demonstrated passion for continuous learning

• Full professional fluency in English (written and verbal)
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Experience in DevOps, Software Engineering, or Application Support roles

• Strong understanding of production environments, monitoring, and incident management processes

• Knowledge of cryptocurrency, digital assets, custody, trading, or blockchain-related solutions

• Knowledge of payment flows, settlement, cut-off, currencies

• Experience with CI/CD tools and automation practices

• Knowledge of web and mobile architectures (APIs, frontend/backend interactions)

• Highly proficient with Jenkins pipelines, Gradle, Artifactory, Python, Groovy, Linux and Bash

• Experience in one or more high level programming language

• Knowledge of Ergon Product Suite

• Knowledge of Avaloq Core ASM and ABR/s with certification

• Full professional fluency in German

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sarete parte del Service Operations – Web & Mobile e Crypto Team, che è responsabile di garantire operazioni di piattaforma stabile e il miglioramento continuo del nostro software e prodotti Avaloq per i nostri clienti.
Come Business Analyst, si agirà come un collegamento chiave tra i nostri clienti, team di servizio e organizzazioni di sviluppo. Sarete responsabili dell'analisi dei requisiti aziendali, dell'indagine e della risoluzione degli incidenti di produzione, e di garantire il funzionamento e la disponibilità senza intoppi delle applicazioni business-critical. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i clienti e le parti interessate interne, vi aiuterà a fornire soluzioni di alta qualità che rispondono alle esigenze aziendali e migliorare l'esperienza clienti globale.
In questo ruolo, collaborerai con gli ingegneri software, i Service Manager, i team di prodotto, i team di Project Delivery e la gestione client per identificare le cause principali, risolvere gli incidenti e migliorare il servizio continuo. Contribuirai in tutto il ciclo di vita del software, dall'analisi dei requisiti e dalla progettazione di soluzioni all'implementazione, al test, alla distribuzione e al supporto post-produzione.

I compiti chiave

• Assicurare il funzionamento stabile ed efficiente delle soluzioni Web & Mobile Banking e Crypto e delle relative applicazioni di terze parti

• Analizzare e consolidare i requisiti del cliente, tradurre le esigenze aziendali in specifiche funzionali e tecniche

• Gestione degli incidenti e delle richieste di assistenza end-to-end, tra cui triage, analisi degli impatti, risoluzione dei problemi, coordinamento e risoluzione

• Agire come punto di contatto affidabile per clienti e stakeholder, gestire le aspettative e garantire una comunicazione efficace

• Sostenere l'imbarco di nuovi servizi bancari nella fornitura di servizi e supporto operativo

• Attività di test di supporto, tra cui validazione funzionale e test di accettazione utente (UAT)

• Contribuire alla consegna di successo dei miglioramenti del prodotto e nuove funzionalità

• Mantenere una chiara documentazione e promuovere attivamente la condivisione delle conoscenze e le migliori pratiche all'interno del team

## Qualifiche

• Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria o equivalente

• Provata esperienza come Business Analyst, o significativa esperienza nel settore dei servizi bancari o finanziari con forti responsabilità di analisi aziendale

• Conoscenza di alto livello dell'infrastruttura delle applicazioni web (DNS, firewall, Web application firewall)

• Conoscenza delle piattaforme di digital banking, mobile banking o web banking

• Familiarità con le soluzioni digitali di bordo, autenticazione, gestione dell'identità o sicurezza

• Familiarità con ambienti cloud e tecnologie di containerizzazione (ad esempio Docker, Kubernetes)

• Conoscenza e esperienza in RDBMS, Oracle SQL, Oracle PL/SQL

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di pensare concettualmente a complesse sfide aziendali

• Competenze nell'analisi dei log, utilizzando unix terminal o una ricerca elastica

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e orientamento clienti, con la capacità di tradurre le esigenze aziendali in requisiti tecnici

• L'approccio di lavoro automotivato, proattivo e organizzato con una passione dimostrata per l'apprendimento continuo

• Fluenza professionale completa in inglese (scritto e verbale)
Sarebbe un vero bonus se avessi

• Esperienza nei ruoli DevOps, Software Engineering o Application Support

• Forte comprensione degli ambienti di produzione, del monitoraggio e dei processi di gestione degli incidenti

• Conoscenza della criptovaluta, dei beni digitali, della custodia, del trading o delle soluzioni connesse alla blockchain

• Conoscenza dei flussi di pagamento, regolamento, cut-off, valute

• Esperienza con strumenti CI/CD e pratiche di automazione

• Conoscenza delle architetture web e mobile (API, interazioni frontend/backend)

• Altamente competente con Jenkins pipelines, Gradle, Artifactory, Python, Groovy, Linux e Bash

• Esperienza in un linguaggio di programmazione ad alto livello

• Conoscenza di Ergon Product Suite

• Conoscenza di Avaloq Core ASM e ABR/s con certificazione

• Fluenza professionale completa in tedesco

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Planning, Analysis and Controlling
jobs.description:
As the Head of FP&A and Controlling, you are the architect of our financial future. This is a high-impact, strategic leadership position designed for a finance expert who can translate complex data into actionable business intelligence, partnering with the business to maximize the value of Avaloq.
You will lead a high-performing multi-country team of 20+, overseeing everything from rigorous bottom-up budgeting to high-level strategic long-range planning and daily controllership for our departments. You will be the CFO’s right hand, ensuring that our financial steering, business partnering, and controlling functions align perfectly with our growth targets.
Key tasks:
Strategic financial planning & analysis

• Lead the development of long-term financial strategies and 3–5 year models that support global expansion and capital allocation in line with our mid-term plan aspirations.

• Conduct sophisticated "what-if" analyses and risk assessments to evaluate potential business outcomes and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

• Analyze industry trends and the competitive landscape to shape effective strategies and establish market standard KPIs to track organizational success.
Advanced controlling & reporting

• Define and oversee our financial steering model and drive finance-related performance management, systematically assessing outcomes and improvement measures.

• Partner with accounting teams to ensure accurate information flow and implement reporting processes that enhance financial transparency across the organization.

• Deep-dive into financial data to identify trends, pinpoint variances, and provide the "narrative" behind the numbers to stakeholders.
Budgeting & cost management

• Establish clear budget guidelines and monitor performance against forecasts to identify areas for cost savings and operational efficiencies

• Implement rigorous cost control methodologies, assessing how cost changes affect profitability and collaborating with department heads to manage key cost drivers.

• Review and approve budget requests based on strategic priorities, ensuring any money spent aligns with organizational goals.
Leadership & business partnering

• Lead and scale a diverse team, fostering a collaborative environment through regular performance evaluations, constructive feedback, and professional development.

• Act as a strategic consultant to business leaders, providing the financial insights necessary to enhance operational performance and decision-making.

• Build strong relationships across the firm, facilitating workshops and training sessions for non-financial managers to synchronize financial goals with operational plans.

• Collaborate with IT and project team to modernize our ERP systems and financial information tools, ensuring the team has the best-in-class cloud-based tech stack for financial management.

## Qualifiche

• 12+ years of senior finance experience, including 5+ years in FP&A and a minimum of 3+ years in a senior leadership role managing teams.

• Evidencible proficiency in advanced financial modelling, forecasting, and cost analysis, with strong mastery of ERP systems, financial reporting software, and data visualisation tools.

• Strong proficiency in financial modelling, forecasting and cost analysis and expert experience of working with ERP systems, financial reporting software, and data visualisation tools.

• Proven capability to set enterprise-level goals and strategies within complex environments.
It would be a real bonus if you have:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. An MBA or Master’s degree in a finance-related discipline

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

titleByLocale.en: Head of Financial Planning, Analysis and Controlling
titleByLocale.de: Leiter Financial Planning, Analysis and Controlling
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Financial Planning, Analysis and Controlling

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come capo della FP&A e del Controlling, sei l'architetto del nostro futuro finanziario. Si tratta di una posizione di leadership strategica ad alto impatto, progettata per un esperto finanziario che può tradurre dati complessi in intelligenza aziendale attuabile, collaborando con il business per massimizzare il valore di Avaloq.
Condurrai un team multi-paese di 20+ ad alte prestazioni, supervisionando tutto, dal rigoroso budgeting bottom-up alla pianificazione strategica di alto livello e dalla gestione quotidiana dei nostri dipartimenti. Sarete la mano destra del CFO, assicurando che il nostro sterzo finanziario, il partner commerciale e le funzioni di controllo si allineano perfettamente con i nostri obiettivi di crescita.
Compiti chiave:
Pianificazione e analisi finanziarie strategiche

• Condurre lo sviluppo di strategie finanziarie a lungo termine e modelli di 3-5 anni che supportano l'espansione globale e l'allocazione di capitale in linea con le nostre aspirazioni di piano a medio termine.

• Condurre sofisticate analisi "what-if" e valutazioni dei rischi per valutare i potenziali risultati aziendali e fornire raccomandazioni strategiche alla leadership senior.

• Analizzare le tendenze del settore e il paesaggio competitivo per modellare strategie efficaci e stabilire KPI standard di mercato per monitorare il successo organizzativo.
Controllo avanzato e reporting

• Definire e supervisionare il nostro modello di sterzo finanziario e guidare la gestione delle prestazioni relative alla finanza, valutare sistematicamente i risultati e le misure di miglioramento.

• Partner con i team di contabilità per garantire un flusso di informazioni accurato e implementare processi di reporting che migliorano la trasparenza finanziaria in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Immergetevi profondamente nei dati finanziari per identificare le tendenze, individuare le variazioni e fornire il "narrativo" dietro i numeri alle parti interessate.
Bilancio e gestione dei costi

• Stabilire chiare linee guida di bilancio e monitorare le prestazioni contro le previsioni per identificare le aree per il risparmio di costi e le efficienze operative

• Implementare metodologie rigorose di controllo dei costi, valutando come i cambiamenti dei costi influiscono sulla redditività e collaborando con i capi di reparto per gestire i driver di costo chiave.

• Verificare e approvare le richieste di bilancio basate su priorità strategiche, assicurando qualsiasi denaro speso allinea con obiettivi organizzativi.
Leadership & business partner

• Guidare e scalare un team diverso, favorendo un ambiente collaborativo attraverso valutazioni regolari delle prestazioni, feedback costruttivo e sviluppo professionale.

• Agire come consulente strategico per i leader aziendali, fornendo le informazioni finanziarie necessarie per migliorare le prestazioni operative e il processo decisionale.

• Costruire relazioni forti in tutta l'azienda, facilitando workshop e sessioni di formazione per manager non finanziari per sincronizzare gli obiettivi finanziari con i piani operativi.

• Collabora con il team IT e project per modernizzare i nostri sistemi ERP e strumenti finanziari di informazione, assicurando che il team abbia lo stack tecnologico cloud-based migliore per la gestione finanziaria.

## Qualifiche

• 12+ anni di esperienza di finanza senior, tra cui 5+ anni in FP&A e un minimo di 3+ anni in un team di gestione ruoli di leadership senior.

• Evidenziabile competenza nella modellazione finanziaria avanzata, nella previsione e nell'analisi dei costi, con una forte padronanza dei sistemi ERP, del software di reporting finanziario e degli strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati.

• Forte competenza nella modellazione finanziaria, nella previsione e nell'analisi dei costi e nell'esperienza esperta di lavorare con sistemi ERP, software di reporting finanziario e strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati.

• Prova capacità di impostare obiettivi e strategie di livello enterprise all'interno di ambienti complessi.
Sarebbe un vero bonus se avete:

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, o un campo correlato. Un MBA o Master in una disciplina legata alla finanza

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Leiter FP&A und Controlling sind Sie der Architekt unserer finanziellen Zukunft. Dies ist eine einflussreiche, strategische Führungsposition, die für einen Finanzexperten konzipiert wurde, der komplexe Daten in umsetzbare Business Intelligence übersetzen kann und mit dem Unternehmen zusammenarbeitet, um den Wert von Avaloq zu maximieren.
Sie werden ein leistungsstarkes Multi-Country-Team mit mehr als 20 Mitarbeitern leiten, das alles von der strengen Bottom-up-Budgetierung bis hin zur strategischen Langzeitplanung auf hoher Ebene und der täglichen Kontrolle für unsere Abteilungen überwacht. Sie werden die rechte Hand des CFO sein und sicherstellen, dass unsere Finanzsteuerung, Geschäftspartner und Controlling-Funktionen perfekt mit unseren Wachstumszielen übereinstimmen.
Hauptaufgaben:
Strategische Finanzplanung & Analyse

• Führen Sie die Entwicklung langfristiger Finanzstrategien und 3-5-Jahres-Modelle an, die die globale Expansion und Kapitalallokation im Einklang mit unseren mittelfristigen Planzielen unterstützen.

• Führen Sie ausgeklügelte "Was-wäre-wenn"-Analysen und Risikobewertungen durch, um potenzielle Geschäftsergebnisse zu bewerten und strategische Empfehlungen für Führungskräfte zu geben.

• Analysieren Sie Branchentrends und die Wettbewerbslandschaft, um effektive Strategien zu entwickeln und marktübliche KPIs zu etablieren, um den organisatorischen Erfolg zu verfolgen.
Advanced Controlling & Reporting

• Definieren und überwachen Sie unser Finanzsteuerungsmodell und steuern Sie das finanzbezogene Performance Management, indem Sie die Ergebnisse und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen systematisch bewerten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Buchhaltungsteams, um einen genauen Informationsfluss zu gewährleisten und Berichtsprozesse zu implementieren, die die finanzielle Transparenz im gesamten Unternehmen verbessern.

• Tauchen Sie tief in Finanzdaten ein, um Trends zu identifizieren, Varianzen zu lokalisieren und den Stakeholdern die "Erzählung" hinter den Zahlen zu liefern.
Budgetierung & Kostenmanagement

• Festlegung klarer Haushaltsleitlinien und Überwachung der Leistung anhand von Prognosen, um Bereiche für Kosteneinsparungen und betriebliche Effizienz zu identifizieren

• Implementieren Sie strenge Kostenkontrollmethoden, bewerten Sie, wie sich Kostenänderungen auf die Rentabilität auswirken, und arbeiten Sie mit Abteilungsleitern zusammen, um die wichtigsten Kostentreiber zu verwalten.

• Überprüfung und Genehmigung von Budgetanträgen auf der Grundlage strategischer Prioritäten, um sicherzustellen, dass das ausgegebene Geld mit den organisatorischen Zielen übereinstimmt.
Leadership & Business Partnering

• Führen und skalieren Sie ein vielfältiges Team und fördern Sie ein kollaboratives Umfeld durch regelmäßige Leistungsbewertungen, konstruktives Feedback und berufliche Entwicklung.

• Handeln Sie als strategischer Berater für Führungskräfte und bieten Sie die finanziellen Einblicke, die erforderlich sind, um die operative Leistung und Entscheidungsfindung zu verbessern.

• Aufbau starker Beziehungen im gesamten Unternehmen, Erleichterung von Workshops und Schulungen für nichtfinanzielle Manager, um finanzielle Ziele mit operativen Plänen zu synchronisieren.

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem IT- und Projektteam zusammen, um unsere ERP-Systeme und Finanzinformationstools zu modernisieren und sicherzustellen, dass das Team über den besten Cloud-basierten Technologie-Stack für das Finanzmanagement verfügt.

## Qualifiziert

• 12+ Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Senior Finance, davon 5+ Jahre im FP&A und mindestens 3+ Jahre in einem Führungsteam.

• Evidenzfähige Kenntnisse in fortgeschrittener Finanzmodellierung, Prognose und Kostenanalyse mit starker Beherrschung von ERP-Systemen, Finanzberichterstattungssoftware und Datenvisualisierungstools.

• Starke Kenntnisse in Finanzmodellierung, Prognose und Kostenanalyse sowie Expertenerfahrung in der Arbeit mit ERP-Systemen, Finanzberichterstattungssoftware und Datenvisualisierungstools.

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, Ziele und Strategien auf Unternehmensebene in komplexen Umgebungen festzulegen.
Es wäre ein echter Bonus, wenn Sie:

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder einem verwandten Bereich. Ein MBA- oder Master-Abschluss in einer finanzbezogenen Disziplin

## Informazioni aggiuntive

Wir wissen, dass das Management der Work-Life-Balance eine Herausforderung ist, der wir alle in unserem täglichen Leben gegenüberstehen, und um dies zu unterstützen, freuen wir uns, den meisten unserer Avaloqer ein hybrides und flexibles Arbeiten anzubieten, um die Work-Life-Balance zu erhalten und unsere fantastische Avaloq-Kultur in unseren globalen Büros fortzusetzen.
Bei Avaloq sind wir stolz darauf, Vielfalt anzunehmen und zu verstehen, dass der Erfolg unseres Unternehmens auf der Kraft unterschiedlicher Meinungen basiert, wir sind von ganzem Herzen bestrebt, eine Chancengleichheit und eine integrative Kultur zu fördern, in der Sie Ihr wahres authentisches Selbst sein können.
Wir stellen, kompensieren und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen, wir haben unser Bestes getan, um diese Anzeige in einer integrativen und neutralen Weise zu schreiben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que chef de la FP&A et du Contrôle, vous êtes l'architecte de notre avenir financier. Il s'agit d'un poste de chef de file stratégique à fort impact conçu pour un expert en finances qui peut traduire des données complexes en intelligence opérationnelle actionnable, en partenariat avec l'entreprise pour maximiser la valeur d'Avaloq.
Vous dirigerez une équipe multipays hautement performante de plus de 20 ans, en supervisant tout, de la budgétisation rigoureuse ascendante à la planification stratégique à long terme et au contrôle quotidien pour nos départements. Vous serez la main droite du CFO, vous assurant que nos fonctions de pilotage financier, de partenariat d'affaires et de contrôle s'harmonisent parfaitement avec nos objectifs de croissance.
Principales tâches :
Planification et analyse financières stratégiques

• Diriger l'élaboration de stratégies financières à long terme et de modèles de trois à cinq ans qui appuient l'expansion mondiale et l'affectation des capitaux conformément à nos aspirations à moyen terme.

• Effectuer des analyses et des évaluations des risques complexes afin d'évaluer les résultats opérationnels potentiels et de formuler des recommandations stratégiques à l'intention des cadres supérieurs.

• Analyser les tendances de l'industrie et le paysage concurrentiel afin d'élaborer des stratégies efficaces et d'établir des ICR standard pour suivre le succès organisationnel.
Contrôle et rapports avancés

• Définir et superviser notre modèle de pilotage financier et diriger la gestion du rendement liée aux finances, en évaluant systématiquement les résultats et les mesures d'amélioration.

• Établir des partenariats avec les équipes de comptabilité afin d'assurer un flux d'information précis et de mettre en oeuvre des processus de rapport qui améliorent la transparence financière dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

• Introduisez-vous dans les données financières afin de cerner les tendances, de cerner les écarts et de fournir le « narratif » derrière les chiffres aux intervenants.
Budgétisation et gestion des coûts

• Établir des lignes directrices budgétaires claires et surveiller le rendement par rapport aux prévisions afin de déterminer les secteurs où il y a lieu de réaliser des économies et d'accroître l'efficacité opérationnelle.

• Mettre en oeuvre des méthodes rigoureuses de contrôle des coûts, évaluer comment les changements de coûts influent sur la rentabilité et collaborer avec les chefs de département pour gérer les principaux facteurs de coûts.

• Examiner et approuver les demandes budgétaires en fonction des priorités stratégiques, en veillant à ce que les fonds dépensés correspondent aux objectifs organisationnels.
Leadership et partenariat d'affaires

• Diriger et mettre à l'échelle une équipe diversifiée, en favorisant un environnement de collaboration au moyen d'évaluations régulières du rendement, de rétroaction constructive et de perfectionnement professionnel.

• Agir en tant que consultant stratégique auprès des chefs d'entreprise, en fournissant les renseignements financiers nécessaires pour améliorer le rendement opérationnel et la prise de décisions.

• Établir des relations solides dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, faciliter les ateliers et les séances de formation à l'intention des gestionnaires non financiers afin de synchroniser les objectifs financiers avec les plans opérationnels.

• Collaborer avec l'équipe IT et projet pour moderniser nos systèmes ERP et nos outils d'information financière, en veillant à ce que l'équipe dispose de la technologie cloud la plus performante pour la gestion financière.

## Qualifiche

• 12 ans et plus d'expérience en finance, dont 5 ans et plus en FP&A et un minimum de 3 ans et plus dans une équipe de gestion de la haute direction.

• Compétences en modélisation financière avancée, en prévision et en analyse des coûts, avec une forte maîtrise des systèmes ERP, des logiciels d'information financière et des outils de visualisation des données.

• Bonne maîtrise de la modélisation financière, de la prévision et de l'analyse des coûts, ainsi que de l'expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP, les logiciels d'information financière et les outils de visualisation des données.

• Capacité éprouvée de fixer des objectifs et des stratégies au niveau de l'entreprise dans des environnements complexes.
Ce serait un vrai bonus si vous aviez:

• Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité ou un domaine connexe. Maîtrise ou maîtrise en finance

## Informations complémentaires

Nous nous rendons compte que la gestion de l'équilibre de vie au travail est un défi auquel nous sommes tous confrontés dans notre vie quotidienne et pour soutenir avec cela nous sommes heureux d'offrir un travail hybride et flexible pour la plupart de nos Avaloqers pour maintenir l'équilibre de vie au travail et pour continuer notre fantastique culture Avaloq dans nos bureaux mondiaux.
À Avaloq, nous sommes fiers d'embrasser la diversité et de comprendre que le succès de notre entreprise est fondé sur la puissance des différentes opinions, nous sommes tout à fait engagés à favoriser un environnement d'égalité des chances et une culture inclusive où vous pouvez être votre véritable soi authentique.
Nous recrutons, compensons et promouvons indépendamment de l'origine, de l'âge, de l'identité de genre, de l'orientation sexuelle ou de tout autre caractère fantastique qui nous rend uniques, nous avons fait de notre mieux pour écrire cette annonce de manière inclusive et neutre.
Veuillez noter que nous n'accepterons aucune soumission de CV spéculative pour l'un de nos rôles des agences de recrutement, et toute soumission non sollicitée sera exemptée de toute attente de paiement.

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
This is a fantastic opportunity to join Avaloq in a Senior Project Manager role, where you will get the opportunity to manage projects within our Product & Development organization, supporting the build and roll-out of new product functionalities or components, to our market-leading clients.
As a key member of our Product Delivery & Quality organization, you will be responsible for leading and delivering complex projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
Your key tasks

• Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans (regulatory and/ or innovation projects), including timelines and budgets, communicating with internal stakeholders (kernel development teams), Regional stakeholders, clients, etc.

• Manage Scope, Risks, Issues, and Quality along the entire lifecycle and in alignment with Top Management / C-suite executives

• Develop mitigation strategies to treat risks and resolve issues as they arise

• Effectively communicate and provide weekly project status, progress, and potential roadblocks to Top Management / C-suite executives

• Bridge the gap between product vision and delivery-oriented approach – ensuring deadlines are met according to the project timeline

• Lead cross-divisions / cross-functional project teams to achieve project objectives and milestones

• Oversee project budgets, ensuring Estimate To Complete (ETC) are constantly reviewed according to the project progress

• Conduct post-project evaluations to identify areas for improvement and lessons learned

• Mentor and develop junior project managers and team members

## Qualifiche

• 8-10 years of Project Management experience, with a track record of successfully delivering complex cross-functional projects, at a senior level, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS and/or BPaaS contexts

• Proven track record of delivering results in a complex international and diverse environment

• Strong knowledge of different project management methodologies (e.g.: Waterfall, Agile, etc.) and software (e.g.: Microsoft Project, Jira, etc.)

• Outstanding communication and presentation abilities, combined with natural ability to manage stakeholders at all levels

• Demonstrated ability to manage risks and develop effective treatment strategies

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines

• Strong experience managing end-to end execution of complex programs that span multiple and cross-functional teams through software project lifecycle

• Exceptional leadership and team motivation skills

• Aptitude to discuss technical details with developers and drive consensus among all stakeholders

• Fluency in English, German is an asset
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent

• Experience in leading RFI&RFP processes, vendor negotiation, contracting, hiring, and managing third parties

• Relevant exposure to financial services industry

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Data Platform Engineer to design, build, and operate a scalable, secure, and governed data platform supporting security, audit, operational, and analytics workloads.
This role is primarily focused on data engineering and data platform development, including data architecture, ingestion pipelines, data modeling, quality controls, governance, and integration with analytics and security platforms. The successful candidate will have strong experience designing and operating data platforms, building reliable batch and streaming pipelines, and managing large volumes of structured and semi-structured data.
The role requires close collaboration with security, infrastructure, and application teams to deliver trusted, high-quality data that enables monitoring, reporting, threat detection, compliance, and business insights.
Your key tasks
Data Platform Architecture

• Design and evolve scalable data platform architectures for security, audit, operational, and analytics data

• Define data storage strategies, schemas, data models, partitioning, retention, and lifecycle management approaches

• Evaluate and prototype new technologies and architectures to improve scalability, performance, and cost efficiency
Data Engineering & Pipelines

• Design, build, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines

• Develop robust ingestion frameworks for logs, audit data, application events, security telemetry, and operational datasets

• Implement data transformation, enrichment, normalization, correlation, and aggregation processes

• Ensure pipelines are reliable, scalable, observable, and resilient
Data Modeling & Storage

• Design relational, analytical, and event-based data models

• Optimize database structures, query performance, indexing, and storage efficiency

• Support the implementation of data lake, warehouse, and lakehouse concepts where appropriate
Data Quality & Governance

• Define and implement data quality controls across ingestion and transformation layers

• Develop validation, reconciliation, deduplication, and completeness checks

• Support data lineage, metadata management, ownership, retention, auditability, and regulatory requirements

• Implement controls for sensitive and regulated data
Platform Integration & Analytics Enablement

• Integrate data from diverse internal and external platforms, applications, databases, APIs, and messaging systems

• Deliver curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, observability, compliance, and security operations

• Support integration with SIEM, monitoring, and business intelligence platforms

• Collaborate with analytics and reporting teams to improve data accessibility and usability
Engineering & Automation

• Develop data engineering services, tooling, and automation using Python and SQL

• Contribute to CI/CD practices for data platform components

• Support infrastructure automation where required, using Terraform and related tooling

• Maintain engineering standards, documentation, and operational procedures

## Qualifiche

• 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Database Engineering, or a related field

• Strong SQL expertise, including schema design, data modeling, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning

• Experience designing and operating production-grade batch and/or streaming data pipelines

• Experience with large-scale data platforms and analytical data architectures

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL

• Experience integrating data from multiple sources, platforms, APIs, and event streams

• Strong understanding of data quality, schema evolution, lineage, governance, and lifecycle management

• Experience with relational databases and analytical storage technologies

• Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and Git-based development practices

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills

• Experience working with sensitive, security-relevant, or regulated data
Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Kafka or other streaming and messaging technologies

• Hands-on administration and search query development with Splunk (SPL) or alternative SIEM/observability stacks (Elasticsearch/Logstash/Kibana, Datadog)

• Experience with modern data platform technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi, Trino, Spark or Parquet

• Experience with data lakehouse architectures

• Experience implementing data quality frameworks and data governance controls

• Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage, and metadata management solutions

• Experience integrating data platforms with analytics tools such as Apache Superset, Power BI, Tableau, or Metabase

• Experience in banking, fintech, cybersecurity, or other regulated industries

• Working knowledge of Terraform and cloud-based data platforms
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Security telemetry and audit-event processing

• SIEM and observability integrations

• Compliance and regulatory reporting datasets

• AI/ML-ready data platform architectures

• Real-time analytics and event-driven architectures

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

jobs.description:
The Legal Reporting team is looking for a committed and competent Technical Business Analyst to carry out requirement analysis, solution design and parameterization activities on Legal Reporting domain. As member of the Legal Reporting  team you will be part of an Agile team that implement high quality and standardized solution for Swiss / European Banks. We work closely together and with other teams, therefore we are looking for a new colleague who – in addition to being independent – also enjoys collaborating with others!

Your key tasks

• Analyse European Bank Authority EBA and Country Regulatory requirements

• Processes according to bank scope by developing standardized solution with Reporting Tool: Fire, WKFS, ABACUS or similar

• Help our customer to be compliant with regulators such EBA, BCL, CSSF, SNB, FINMA, NBB, BDF

• Build and parameterize Regulatory reporting solutions in Avaloq (training will be provided) in an Agile environment

• Participate in implementation workshops

• Actively manage Internal and External Stakeholders relationship by communicating regularly during the implementation

• Place of work Bioggio/Remote with possibility to join client project  for on-site working group across Europe and Asia

## Qualifiche

• University degree in Computer Science/Engineering/Mathematics or equivalent Business degree

• Strong analytical, problem solving and conceptual skills

• Strong command of the English language

• Excellent client-orientation and strong communication skills with a service-oriented attitude

• Proactive, self-motivated with passion for learning and self-improvement
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Experience with banking industry/systems/Avaloq Banking Suite

• Experiences with SQL / PLSQL

• Experiences with Legal Reporting Tool Fire, WKFS, ABACUS  or similar

• Experiences with Regulators EBA, BCL, CSSF, SNB, FINMA, NBB, BDF

• Italian, German and French are a plus

jobs.title: Test Specialist
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Test Specialist to join our dynamic team in Bioggio, Switzerland. As a key member of the project team, you will be responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software to the client.
Your key tasks

• Develop and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts for complex software applications

• Proactively propose and adopt best practices and methodologies for test, including harnessing AI

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve software defects

• Analyse test results and provide detailed reports to stakeholders

• Conduct performance testing and identify areas for optimization

• Work closely with project manager, development teams and other stakeholders to manage risks and issues

• Design, update and execute functional and business test scenarios and test cases based on functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring their reusability

• Support test environments issues to ensure testing can be completed on time (baseline definition and maintenance, assessment on environment readiness)

• Document and evaluate the result of the testing, investigate testing deficiencies

• Adhere closely to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) concepts

• Support and maintain automated testing frameworks to improve efficiency and coverage

• Contribute to continuous improvement of Test Management processes and procedures

## Qualifiche

• University degree in Computer Science, or similar

• Minimum of 3-5 years of work experience within the banking/financial services industry, especially in testing function

• In-depth knowledge of Test concepts and methodology

• Excellent written/verbal communication skills in English with an emphasis on client service and presentation

• Must be an excellent team player and willing to share knowledge as well ad high level of stress management ability

jobs.title: Cloud Security Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate Cloud Security Architect to join our Cloud Architecture team. This role combines cloud architecture and security engineering with automation, and DevSecOps practices to help design and secure next-generation cloud platforms and services.

Your Key Tasks

• Design, govern, and continuously evolve secure cloud architectures for SaaS, PaaS, and internal platforms

• Define and maintain cloud security standards, reusable architecture patterns, reference architectures, and security blueprints

• Embed security-by-design principles into landing zones, tenancy structures, network segmentation, identity models, and cloud guardrails

• Drive the adoption of Zero Trust, least-privilege, and defense-in-depth security strategies across the cloud landscape

• Integrate security controls and compliance requirements into CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and platform automation frameworks

• Lead or support security assessments, threat modeling, risk analysis, and architecture reviews

• Provide architectural guidance for network security and connectivity designs across internal, SaaS, and PaaS environments

• Partner with the Network Architecture team to define enterprise network standards and reusable architecture patterns, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant connectivity solutions across all platforms and environments

• Ensure alignment with regulatory, compliance, and security requirements, translating them into practical and implementable architectural solutions

• Evaluate emerging cloud security technologies and drive continuous improvements in the organization's security posture
Collaboration & Mentoring

• Work closely with Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, DevOps teams, Security Operations, and Product teams

• Provide guidance and coaching on secure cloud adoption

• Help drive cloud transformation and modernization initiatives

• Collaborate with engineering teams to improve automation, reliability, and operational security

## Qualifiche

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as an IT Security Architect, Cloud Security Architect, or in a similar senior security or architecture role

• Experience designing and governing enterprise cloud architectures in Cloud Infrastructure (OCI preferred)

• Experience with Cloud Network Architecture, managing complex network topologies and related topics

• Experience with risk assessments, threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and security-by-design methodologies

• Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation technologies such as Terraform/OpenTofu, CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and Policy-as-Code
The following certifications are considered a strong advantage:

• CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

• CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

• OCI Security Architect Professional

• OCI certifications in Cloud Security and Network Architecture

• Equivalent architecture or cybersecurity certifications

jobs.title: Senior Database Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Database Platform Engineer, you will help transform Oracle database operations into a fully automated, secure, and scalable platform. Working within an agile delivery team, you will design and maintain automation across the entire database lifecycle, ensuring reliable, auditable, and resilient database services while minimizing manual intervention.
Your key tasks

• Automate the complete Oracle database lifecycle, including provisioning, cloning, refresh, reconfiguration, backup, restore, and decommissioning using Terraform, Ansible, and scripting.

• Develop and maintain automation that provisions databases to Avaloq standards and performs post-clone configuration without manual intervention.

• Deliver and operate automated workflows for day-to-day database operations, including restart, resize, housekeeping, parameter changes, Oracle Home switches, and standard incident recovery actions.

• Manage database configuration and parameters through GitOps practices, ensuring full version control, traceability, and auditability.

• Build and enhance backup, recovery, and disaster recovery automation, including Data Guard Broker switchovers, instance recovery, and DR testing.

• Drive platform standardization through immutable infrastructure by maintaining operating system and Oracle Home images that eliminate configuration drift and reduce maintenance effort.

• Automate large-scale database refreshes across ACP and non-ACP environments and maintain the central automation framework supporting development, testing, and support teams.

• Manage database security by overseeing the TDE key lifecycle, secrets management, and privileged access controls, ensuring secure and auditable encryption at rest.

• Contribute code, participate in peer reviews, run CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate closely with Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, Service Operations, Software Architects, and operational DBAs.

## Qualifiche

• 5+ years of experience as an Oracle DBA or Database Engineer in a production, mission-critical environment.

• University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field.

• Strong hands-on Oracle expertise, including installation, patching, upgrades, Oracle Home and parameter management, Data Guard, RMAN, backup and recovery, TDE, cloning, refreshes, and performance troubleshooting.

• Proven experience in automation using Ansible, Terraform or OpenTofu, Git, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting in Python and Shell. You have successfully replaced manual operational processes with code.

• Solid understanding of public cloud platforms, preferably OCI, as well as Linux, storage, networking, secrets management, and container technologies such as Kubernetes.

• Experience working in regulated and security-conscious environments with strong knowledge of auditability, segregation of duties, vulnerability management, and patch management. Experience within financial services is considered an advantage.

• Strong engineering mindset focused on automation, infrastructure as code, reliability, and continuous improvement.

• Effective communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate within international, agile, and distributed teams. German and/or Italian are considered an asset.

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

I compiti chiave

## Qualifiche

• 5+ anni di esperienza come Oracle DBA o Database Engineer in un ambiente di produzione, mission-critical.

• Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, o un campo comparabile.

• Forte esperienza di Oracle hands-on, tra cui installazione, patching, aggiornamenti, Oracle Home e gestione dei parametri, Data Guard, RMAN, backup e recupero, TDE, clonazione, rinfreschi e risoluzione dei problemi delle prestazioni.

• Esperienza comprovata nell'automazione con Ansible, Terraform o OpenTofu, Git, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines e scripting in Python e Shell. Hai sostituito con successo i processi operativi manuali con il codice.

As a Senior Database Platform Engineer, you will help transform Oracle database operations into a fully automated, secure, and scalable platform. Working within an agile delivery team, you will design and maintain automation across the entire database lifecycle, ensuring reliable, auditable, and resilient database services while minimizing manual intervention.
Your key tasks

• Automate the complete Oracle database lifecycle, including provisioning, cloning, refresh, reconfiguration, backup, restore, and decommissioning using Terraform, Ansible, and scripting.

• Develop and maintain automation that provisions databases to Avaloq standards and performs post-clone configuration without manual intervention.

• Deliver and operate automated workflows for day-to-day database operations, including restart, resize, housekeeping, parameter changes, Oracle Home switches, and standard incident recovery actions.

• Manage database configuration and parameters through GitOps practices, ensuring full version control, traceability, and auditability.

• Build and enhance backup, recovery, and disaster recovery automation, including Data Guard Broker switchovers, instance recovery, and DR testing.

• Drive platform standardization through immutable infrastructure by maintaining operating system and Oracle Home images that eliminate configuration drift and reduce maintenance effort.

• Automate large-scale database refreshes across ACP and non-ACP environments and maintain the central automation framework supporting development, testing, and support teams.

• Manage database security by overseeing the TDE key lifecycle, secrets management, and privileged access controls, ensuring secure and auditable encryption at rest.

• Contribute code, participate in peer reviews, run CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate closely with Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, Service Operations, Software Architects, and operational DBAs.

## Qualifiche

• 5+ years of experience as an Oracle DBA or Database Engineer in a production, mission-critical environment.

• University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field.

• Strong hands-on Oracle expertise, including installation, patching, upgrades, Oracle Home and parameter management, Data Guard, RMAN, backup and recovery, TDE, cloning, refreshes, and performance troubleshooting.

• Proven experience in automation using Ansible, Terraform or OpenTofu, Git, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting in Python and Shell. You have successfully replaced manual operational processes with code.

• Solid understanding of public cloud platforms, preferably OCI, as well as Linux, storage, networking, secrets management, and container technologies such as Kubernetes.

• Experience working in regulated and security-conscious environments with strong knowledge of auditability, segregation of duties, vulnerability management, and patch management. Experience within financial services is considered an advantage.

• Strong engineering mindset focused on automation, infrastructure as code, reliability, and continuous improvement.

• Effective communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate within international, agile, and distributed teams. German and/or Italian are considered an asset.

jobs.description:
The Corporate Real Estate Manager leads key real estate initiatives and projects in Zurich while supporting the execution of Avaloq’s global Corporate Real Estate strategy across its international portfolio.
The role is responsible for delivering real estate and workplace projects, managing lease and portfolio-related activities, and ensuring effective project governance, reporting, financial controls, and stakeholder engagement, as well as driving local facility management matters. Working closely with internal stakeholders, senior leadership, landlords, consultants, and external partners, the Corporate Real Estate Manager balances multiple priorities, manages complex programmes, and ensures successful delivery through strong project management, commercial acumen, and operational excellence.
Your key tasks

• Lead the planning and delivery of real estate, workplace, and portfolio projects, including office expansions, relocations, refurbishments, consolidations, and workplace transformation initiatives.

• Support the implementation of Avaloq's Corporate Real Estate strategy across the global property portfolio.

• Manage projects throughout the full lifecycle, including business case development, planning, procurement, governance, delivery, handover, and post-project review.

• Lead or support lease negotiations, renewals, rent reviews, and landlord relationships.

• Develop business cases, investment proposals, portfolio analyses, and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.

• Establish and maintain effective project governance, reporting frameworks, approvals, risk registers, and control processes.

• Monitor and report on project performance, budgets, forecasts, milestones, risks, and key deliverables.

• Ensure robust financial management through budget control, forecasting, cost tracking, purchase order management, and invoice governance.

• Coordinate internal stakeholders, business leaders, landlords, brokers, consultants, contractors, and service providers to deliver successful project outcomes.

• Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and change controls, ensuring appropriate mitigation and escalation where required.

• Maintain accurate project documentation, reporting packs, governance records, and audit trails.

• Support procurement activities, supplier selection processes, contract negotiations, and vendor performance management.

• Drive portfolio optimisation, sustainability, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement initiatives across the real estate portfolio.

• Provide advisory support on workplace and property matters, working with operational teams and service providers where required.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment, engagement, and effective communication throughout project delivery.

• Serve as the on-site Safety Officer ( SIBE ), ensure workplace safety for staff and external contractors. Plan, lead, and log mandatory periodic evacuation drills.

## Qualifiche

• Master's degree in Real Estate, Business Administration, Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio management, property transactions, project management, or workplace transformation.

• Proven experience leading complex real estate projects and programmes within an international environment.

• Strong knowledge of lease management, landlord negotiations, portfolio planning, property transactions, and project delivery.

• Demonstrable experience in governance, financial management, reporting, controls, and risk management.

• Experience preparing business cases, management reports, board papers, and strategic recommendations.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.

• Experience managing suppliers, consultants, contractors, and external partners.

• Familiarity with Swiss workplace safety regulations and prior experience acting as a site Safety Officer ( SIBE ) or managing building emergency concepts

• Project Management qualification (PRINCE2 or equivalent) is highly desirable.

• Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

• Fluency in German and English.

• Additional French or Italian language skills would be beneficial.
What You Bring

• A strategic and commercially minded approach combined with strong execution skills.

• The ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders within a fast-paced international environment.

• Strong negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management capabilities.

• A proactive, structured, analytical, and solution-oriented mindset.

• A strong focus on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and delivery of measurable business outcomes

• Confidence working with senior leaders and representing Corporate Real Estate across the organisation.

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di Project Manager, guiderai progetti complessi di implementazione del cliente, coordinando team interfunzionali per fornire le soluzioni BPaaS e SaaS di Avaloq nel tempo, nel budget e ai più elevati standard di qualità.
I compiti chiave

• Guidare la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e la consegna di progetti di cambiamento-the-bank per i principali clienti bancari globali di Avaloq. Ciò include il lavoro con le relative unità Avaloq (Solution Architects/Consultants, Infrastructure, Support Services, Regional Banking Operations, rappresentanti dei clienti, ecc.) e le risorse partner, se del caso, per definire gli obiettivi del progetto ed eseguire il piano di progetto concordato.

• Prepara budget di progetto e offerte commerciali in stretta collaborazione con Avaloq Solution Architects/Consultants e Key Account Managers per la presentazione e la negoziazione con i clienti potenziali e esistenti.

• Raggiungere gli obiettivi di progetto definiti, tra cui portata, qualità, tempi, budget, reporting, project staffing (internal Avaloq e partner esterni), e recensioni post-progetto.

• Consulti e istruisci i project manager e i team dei clienti per sfruttare le migliori pratiche e processi aziendali riflessi in Avaloq's Banking Reference.

• Progetti di piombo contemporaneamente, sostenendo le attività pre-vendita e le proposte per i potenziali clienti.

• Assicurarsi che i consegnabili sono completati in tempo e soddisfare gli standard di qualità richiesti.

## Qualifiche

• Provato record di traccia come leader globale del progetto per progetti su larga scala, preferibilmente coinvolgendo l'implementazione di soluzioni software standard

• Laurea in Informatica, Business Administration, Economia aziendale, Ingegneria o un campo relativo

• Certificazione di Project Management da un organismo accreditato riconosciuto

• Conoscenza dell'industria bancaria e dei processi legati alla banca

• Forte capacità di negoziazione con comprovata esperienza coinvolgendo gli stakeholder fino a livello del comitato direttivo

• Esperienza di leadership nella gestione di team interdisciplinari e multiculturali

• Persistente, assertivo e resiliente, con la capacità di mantenere una panoramica e impostare le priorità in modo efficace

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e presentazione in inglese
Sarebbe un vero bonus se avessi

• Esperienza nei progetti internazionali di piattaforma di cambiamento-the-bank

• Certificazione PMP

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

• Führen Sie die Planung, Durchführung und Lieferung von Change-the-Bank-Projekten für die wichtigsten globalen Bankkunden von Avaloq. • Führen Sie gleichzeitig Projekte und unterstützen Sie Pre-Sales-Aktivitäten und Vorschläge für potenzielle Kunden.

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informationstechnologie, Betriebswirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung durch eine anerkannte Akkreditierungsstelle

• Kenntnisse der Bankenbranche und bankbezogene Prozesse

• Führungserfahrung im Management interdisziplinärer und multikultureller Teams

• Anhaltend, durchsetzungsfähig und belastbar, mit der Fähigkeit, den Überblick zu behalten und Prioritäten effektiv zu setzen

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und Präsentation Fähigkeiten in Englisch
Es wäre ein echter Bonus, wenn Sie

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que gestionnaire de projet, vous dirigerez des projets complexes de mise en oeuvre client, coordonnant des équipes interfonctionnelles pour fournir les solutions BPaaS et SaaS d'Avaloq dans les délais, dans les limites du budget et selon les normes de qualité les plus élevées.
Vos tâches clés

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, PaaS & Cloud Automation
jobs.description:
• Own the Architecture & Technology  projects end to end. Take projects from initiation through execution to closure — cloud platforms, platform automation, middleware and the IaaS/PaaS/SaaS services built on top — and be accountable for the result, not just the plan.

• Lead technical delivery teams and go deep with them. Instruct and steer engineering teams from analysis and architecture through development to live service, deep-diving into the technology yourself and driving consensus where opinions differ.

• Run sound project governance. Set up and manage financials, resources, scope, quality and timeline; identify risks and issues early, remove blockers for the team, and secure buy-in from senior stakeholders, peers and engineers.

• Manage client and sales expectations. Be the credible voice towards clients and internal sales throughout the implementation — clear status, honest timelines, and a polished business and technical pitch up to C-suite and Board level.

• Bridge business vision and technical reality. Translate our service and product ambitions into concrete technical implementation — and translate technical constraints back into commercial language senior stakeholders can decide on.

## Qualifiche

• Five or more years in project management for technical, cross-functional projects — plus a university degree in technology, business or a comparable field.

• Track record of leading technical teams and driving infrastructure delivery initiatives
